decisions.reason: Conferencing has been commoditised by cloud collaboration platforms since the pandemic and no longer appears on the website, which makes withdrawal more likely, but it still complements the voice bundle for existing enterprise customers.
Metro data centre connectivity is core to the firm's fibre and data centre strategy, so dropping it is very unlikely.
Optical spectrum services monetise the firm's owned fibre for high-bandwidth customers, which fits its strategic direction.
The self-service number portal supports real-time provisioning at low cost, though it could be folded into a broader customer portal.
Direct voice connections stay relevant as enterprises move to SIP and cloud voice, such as Teams direct routing.
